paite: Ka lungtang thil hoih in adimlet a, kumpipa tungtang thu a ka laphuah ka gen ding hi; ka lei laigelh siamtak laigelhna ahi.
heading: Lapu Lian A Ding, Shoshannim Sak Ding; Korah Tate La, Maskil, Itna La / Kumpipa Zineihna La
english: For the Chief Musician. Set to “The Lilies.” A contemplation by the sons of Korah. A wedding song. My heart overflows with a noble theme. I recite my verses for the king. My tongue is like the pen of a skillful writer.

paite: Mihing tate sang in na mel ahoihzaw a; hehpihna in na muk akinuh hi; huaiziak in Pathian in tangtawn a ding in ahon vualzawl ahi.
english: You are the most excellent of the sons of men. Grace has anointed your lips, therefore God has blessed you forever.

paite: Aw, mihat, na kawng ah namsau vom in, na thupina leh na kilawmna toh.
english: Strap your sword on your thigh, O mighty one, in your splendor and your majesty.

paite: Thutak leh thunuailutna leh diktatna ziak in na kilawmna silh in lamzangtak in sakol tung a tuang in pai zel in; huchi in na khut taklam in thil mulkimhuaite ahon hilh ding ahi.
english: In your majesty ride on victoriously on behalf of truth, humility, and righteousness. Let your right hand display awesome deeds.

paite: Na thal azum a; michih na nuai ah apuk zel uh, kumpipa melmate lungtang ah atal hi.
english: Your arrows are sharp. The nations fall under you, with arrows in the heart of the king’s enemies.

paite: Pathian aw, na laltutphah tangtawn in a-om ding ahi, khentuam neihlouhna lalchiang na gam lalchiang ahi.
english: Your throne, God, is forever and ever. A scepter of equity is the scepter of your kingdom.

paite: Diktatna na deih a, gilou-salou na hua hi, huaiziak in, Pathian, na Pathian in, na lawmte sang in nakpi in nopna thau ahon nilhta hi.
english: You have loved righteousness, and hated wickedness. Therefore God, your God, has anointed you with the oil of gladness above your fellows.

paite: Na puansilh tengteng murrah gimte, aloe gimte, sing gimte anam vungvung a; saiha a bawl kumpipa' inn a kaihging chi tuamtuam ging hong pawtte'n ahon hihnuam ahi.
english: All your garments smell like myrrh, aloes, and cassia. Out of ivory palaces stringed instruments have made you glad.

paite: Na numei hoihte lak ah kumpipate tanute apang ua; na taklam ah Ophir dangka-eng a kizem in kumpinu adingh hi.
english: Kings’ daughters are among your honorable women. At your right hand the queen stands in gold of Ophir.

paite: Ka tanu aw, ngaikhia inla, ngaihtuah inla, bildoh in; na mite leh na pa inn a mite mangngilh in.
english: Listen, daughter, consider, and turn your ear. Forget your own people, and also your father’s house.

paite: Huchi in kumpipa'n na melhoih adeih ding hi, amah i TOUPA ahi ngal a; amah bia in.
english: So the king will desire your beauty, honor him, for he is your lord.

paite: Tura tanu thilpiak tawi in huai ah a-om ding a; mi lak a hausate ngei in na deihsakna angen ding uhi.
english: The daughter of Tyre comes with a gift. The rich among the people entreat your favor.

paite: Kumpipa insung a kumpipa tanu athupi zou hial a, apuansilh dangka-eng a zep kilawm ahi.
english: The princess inside is all glorious. Her clothing is interwoven with gold.

paite: Puankhui kilawm silh in kumpipa kiang ah api ding ua, amah zui alawm nungakte na kiang ah api ding uh.
english: She shall be led to the king in embroidered work. The virgins, her companions who follow her, shall be brought to you.

paite: Kipak leh nuam in api ding ua, kumpipa' inn ah alut ding uh.
english: With gladness and rejoicing they shall be led. They shall enter into the king’s palace.

paite: Na pate sik in na tate a-om ding ua; leitung tengteng ah milian in amaute na bawl ding.
english: Your sons will take the place of your fathers. You shall make them princes in all the earth.

paite: Na min suan tengteng ah theihgige ding in ka bawl ding; huaiziak in michih in tangtawn tangtawn in kipahthu ahon hilh ding uh.
english: I will make your name to be remembered in all generations. Therefore the peoples shall give you thanks forever and ever.
